crosstalk.classification: baseline residual requiring a separately paired targeted-remedy analysis; not an open-problem claim
crosstalk.why_not_global_collapse: Output target-selective cosine is large while global token cosine is much smaller. These descriptive cosines do not identify causal routing or rule out multi-cluster structure.
crosstalk.why_not_threshold_only: Cells 3 and 7 retain base/donor/Walsh error as well as swap error; cells 6 and 11 are much closer to the registered swap threshold.

factorial_effects.inference_scope: All 160 runs pass the base routing gate. Because only 12/16 cells pass the stricter swap gate, rank effects are not yet a strict functional-equivalence capacity law.

full_causal_robustness_gate.inference_scope: Per-seed threshold screen on one fixed evaluation stream; a cell pass count is not a confidence interval for its mean crosstalk.

gates.interpretation: All tuned runs solve base retrieval. On the fixed b=256 evaluation stream, 4 cells do not reach the registered 10/10 per-seed gate; this is distinct from a cell-mean crosstalk claim.

optimizer_tuning.interpretation_guardrail: Rank from a failed high-learning-rate run is an optimization outcome, not capacity evidence. Factorial rank inference uses tuned runs only.

representation_geometry.aggregation: average H×FFN architectures within seed, then bootstrap 10 seeds
representation_geometry.identification_limit: Neither cosine is a causal-routing estimand or a multi-cluster order parameter.
